script.vo: Look at where the numbers sit in the cell. If they hug the left, they're text. If they hug the right, they're real numbers.

post.title: VLOOKUP says #N/A but the value is right there
post.description:
vlookup returns #N/A even though the value exists
Account codes from a GL export often come in as text. Multiply the lookup value by 1 and the match comes back. Save this for close.
